Release Highlights
August 21, 2026

Meetily can now start and stop recording on its own with a countdown you can cancel, gives you a floating pill to control recording without leaving your call, and lets you choose where recordings are saved - plus smarter meeting detection and a round of reliability fixes.
Automatic recording starts when you join a meeting and stops when it ends, each with a countdown you can cancel (off by default)
A floating recording pill lets you pause or stop without leaving your call, and stays clear of full-screen apps
Choose where recordings are saved, and move, copy, back up, or delete them any time - with optional automatic retention
Smarter meeting detection sees every microphone and confirms a meeting has truly ended before it stops
Smoother transcript scrolling with synced playback on long meetings, plus a range of reliability fixes
Table of Contents
What's New in Pro 1.9.2

This release makes recording effortless. Meetily can now start and stop on its own, gives you a floating pill to control a recording without leaving your call, and puts you in charge of where your recordings live. Meeting detection is smarter, and a round of reliability fixes makes the whole experience steadier.
If you are coming from an earlier build, this update rolls up everything since 1.8.2 into a single upgrade.
Automatic Recording

Meetily can start recording on its own when you join a meeting and stop when it ends. Each action shows a countdown you can cancel, so you are always in control and nothing records by surprise. It is off by default - turn it on in Settings whenever you want it.

children.alt: Meetily Recording Settings showing the Floating Recording Pill toggle alongside Start Recording Automatically and Stop Recording Automatically, each with a countdown you can cancel before it begins or ends

children.text: Floating Recording Pill
A small, draggable pill lets you pause or stop recording without leaving your call. It stays out of the way of full-screen apps, so screen sharing and presentations are never blocked.

children.alt: The floating Meetily recording pill showing a live recording indicator and elapsed time, so you can pause or stop without switching back to the app

children.text: Your Recordings, Where You Want Them

Choose where your recordings are saved, and move, copy, back up, or delete them any time. Optional retention clears older audio for you automatically, so your storage stays tidy without any manual cleanup.
Smarter Meeting Detection

Meetily now sees every microphone on your machine and confirms a meeting has truly ended before it stops recording. If it ever calls a meeting over too early, you can decline the false "meeting ended" and keep going.
Stability & Reliability

Transcripts now scroll more smoothly, with playback that stays in sync even on long meetings. This release also brings a range of reliability improvements across recording, device selection, and the interface.
Upgrade
The app will prompt you to update via the in-app update dialog. Click "Update Now!" to install. All existing settings, recordings, and models are preserved.
